name: Spirits of Lunara
detailed_description:
Spirits of Lunara is still in the early stages of development, and each new update brings the game closer to its final vision. As you follow the development progress, you'll see the world grow, new elements added, and mechanics enhanced. Your journey with us is just beginning, and we hope you'll join us as we shape Lunara into a unique and memorable experience.

The Call of the Forest

The Ancestral Forest has been known by many names throughout the ages: Eden, Yggdrasil, and even the Forest of First Whispers. Today, it is called Lunara, a sacred place that emanates wisdom, vitality, and power. But something disturbing threatens the peace of the forest, and a new hero must rise to restore balance.

Spirits of Lunara is a 2D metroidvania with challenging combat, exploration, and a rich, immersive narrative. Explore a world, help the spirits, and face the corruption that has tainted the forest and all who inhabit it.

Mechanics

  • Combat – Experiment with different combat styles to exploit enemy weaknesses.

  • Exploration – Explore the forest, unlock new areas, and defeat enemies.

  • Evolve with the spirits – Find ancient spirits that grant special powers, changing your gameplay style.

  • Narrative – Uncover the truth of Lunara through forgotten notes, spirit memories, and the whispers of the forest.
